integrity: Exact mathematical proof and reproducible finite-state calculations are provided. Numerical enumerations do not certify infinite statements. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns homogeneous complete graphs, continuous-time power-law imitation with a common positive exponent, and one focal opinion. It supplies sharp pathwise binary bounds, not full multicolor fixation laws or a general-network result.
title: Sharp binary envelopes for multistate nonlinear voter dynamics
